steps.content:
<size=45>July 15, N.F. 115 01:35
Operation BR-005 commences in...</size>
10 days 14 hours 12 minutes
You make your final preparations at the lighthouse summit, fortifying it to endure a night of storms and monstrous assault.
The lens is cracked. I've patched the wiring, but the batteries are shot. If we pulse the light every five minutes, we might just make it to dawn. We can't afford to waste a single charge.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: The window barricades are up, but they won't hold forever!

Ceto scavenges the ruins, piling movable iron grates, shattered toolboxes, and salvaged railings across the entrance—barricading every possible point where monsters might climb. From a distance, the structure looks like nothing so much as a birdcage perched high above the chaos.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: When that rescue team gets here... they're going to think we're insane.
Are we not?

She doesn't deny it. Instead, she rips the blood-soaked bandage from her arm, clamps one end between her teeth, and begins lashing her dagger tightly to her right hand. The cloth wraps over broken blisters, biting deep into raw flesh, yet she doesn't so much as flinch.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Then watch your back. This lunatic sees red... you'll just be the next body on the floor.
You won't.
I'm not letting that blade take you.
No more words are needed. Bound by the shackles' fragile connection, you turn away and return to your posts. You throw the switch on the battery pack; she takes her position at the frontline.

The beacon flares back to life, greedily consuming the power you had so painstakingly charged. Its beam slices through the sheeting rain, and from below, a fresh wave of monstrous howls answers the light. The sound of scrabbling claws draws nearer—but behind you, Ceto stands energized, almost anticipatory.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Hey, DisCity native. Remember that bet we made when you first got here?
Of course. You bet neither of us would survive the night.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: How about another bet? You in?
Bet on what?

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Miles's recipe is the prize. I bet we...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: ...both live to see the sun next morning!

With a guttural roar, she charges forward, surrendering completely to the Rancor. Every shred of restraint is gone; her dagger becomes a whirlwind of silver, each strike carrying the ferocity of one who fights not to survive, but to ensure her enemies die with her.
This is no longer human combat; it is something older, more savage: a primal hunger for pure destruction.
Until the tide falls at dawn
